operating_rules: Use synthetic data only; no clinical or real-business conclusions.
Run one step at a time and stop at its checkpoint.
Offline first for this acceptance exercise; the application default remains live-first HYBRID.
Check all nine categories against the committed baseline; never regenerate expected values to hide failure.
A notebook-creation rehearsal is SIMULATED and is not a data correction or notebook run.
Cloud mutations need a separate exact-target approved plan.
Claude Code equivalents are DOCUMENTED ONLY; no cross-harness performance claim.
scenario: Detect quality defects, reconcile an independent baseline and rehearse a governed notebook proposal.

steps.checkpoint: The learner names the baseline, grain and authority boundary.
steps.claude_code_prompt: Read this guide and governed-data-foundations. Explain order-line grain, the nine committed quality categories and why fluent model output does not establish correctness. No cloud calls.
steps.copilot_prompt: Read this guide, the manufacturing profile and its committed expected baseline. Explain the order-line grain, nine quality categories and the separation between explanation and proof. Read the governed-data-foundations lesson at your chosen depth. No cloud calls or edits.
evidence_required: A written contract names all nine categories and excludes automatic corrections.
failure_modes: An ambiguous grain must be clarified before aggregation.
not_evidence: An explanation or checked checkbox is not executed quality validation.
steps.objective: Explain grain, duplicate-sensitive aggregates and why a model is not a baseline.
steps.offline_equivalent: Read the existing five-level foundations and research brief.
steps.title: Define the quality contract

steps.checkpoint: All nine counts match exactly and the command exits zero.
steps.claude_code_prompt: Run ffia mfg quality --check --json and report the nine counts and independent baseline result as LOCAL. Stop on mismatch without regenerating the baseline.
steps.copilot_prompt: Run ffia mfg quality --check --json locally. Report the LOCAL label, baseline_passed and nine observed counts. On any mismatch, stop and inspect the check or input; do not rewrite expected values. No Fabric or Foundry call.
evidence_required: LOCAL baseline_passed=true with counts 12, 9, 7, 5, 3, 8, 4, 4 and 6 by named category.
failure_modes: Missing raw files or a baseline mismatch blocks the checkpoint.
steps.objective: Detect nine categories and compare exact counts with the independent committed baseline.
steps.title: Reconcile all quality findings

steps.checkpoint: The adverse-case test observes a failed baseline gate; the original baseline still passes.
steps.claude_code_prompt: Run tests/offline/test_use_case_authoring.py and explain how a scratch baseline mismatch exits nonzero. Do not edit committed data or claim production validation.
steps.copilot_prompt: Run the offline authoring regression in tests/offline/test_use_case_authoring.py. Explain its scratch baseline mutation and failed reconciliation. Keep committed data unchanged. State that detecting a controlled discrepancy is not production-scale validation.
evidence_required: A passing test records the intentionally failing scratch reconciliation.
failure_modes: Changing the committed expectation invalidates the experiment.
steps.objective: Demonstrate that a nonzero mismatch is detected without changing repository data.
steps.offline_equivalent: Network-blocked pytest with isolated synthetic files.
steps.title: Challenge the baseline in a scratch copy

steps.checkpoint: The learner separates optional item visibility from deterministic quality evidence.
steps.claude_code_prompt: Explain the optional Fabric MCP read-only catalogue path and named LOCAL fallback. Do not invoke a cloud tool without confirming the target scope. Metadata is not quality validation.
steps.copilot_prompt: For the connected option, first state Microsoft Fabric / fabric-mcp / core_search-catalog. Perform only read-only catalogue inspection against the approved demo scope. If unavailable, report the error and use only ffia-local list_fabric_items as LOCAL. Do not publish identifiers. Metadata cannot prove the nine quality counts. Skip cloud calls for the offline acceptance path.
evidence_required: A scoped read result with its actual label
failure_modes: Unavailable primary tooling cannot silently become a REST or CLI call.
not_evidence: An existing item is not proof of notebook execution.
steps.objective: Distinguish live item metadata from locally calculated quality measurements.
steps.offline_equivalent: Explain the primary and fallback using the fabric-mcp-landscape lesson without calling cloud tools.
steps.title: Compare optional Fabric MCP context

fallback.label: LOCAL
fallback.note: Disclose primary unavailability; this does not satisfy live verification.

steps.checkpoint: SIMULATED verification and audit exist; duplicate execution and self-approval are refused.
steps.claude_code_prompt: Explain and rehearse LOCAL create_notebook for dq_review_notebook through the offline API. Require separate approval and inspect SIMULATED verification and audit. Do not run a notebook or correct data.
steps.copilot_prompt: In the offline workshop, draft a create_notebook plan for dq_review_notebook, destination LOCAL. Review the exact target and explain that creation does not execute a correction. Use a separate approver, execute the SIMULATED rehearsal, and inspect verification and audit.
evidence_required: SIMULATED result and correlated audit records.
failure_modes: Duplicate execution requires a new reviewed plan and cannot repeat the effect.
not_evidence: Notebook creation is not a corrected dataset or live notebook run.
steps.objective: Practice plan validation, separate approval, simulated creation and audit without changing data.
steps.offline_equivalent: Use the step's existing shared rehearsal panel.

rehearsal.note: Simulation of notebook creation only; no remediation code runs.

steps.title: Rehearse a governed notebook proposal

steps.checkpoint: The learner can reproduce the baseline and explain which claims remain unverified.
steps.claude_code_prompt: Map requirements to observed tests, distinguish LOCAL and SIMULATED outcomes, and list live and production gaps. Keep Claude Code execution DOCUMENTED ONLY unless actually run.
steps.copilot_prompt: Compare this guide's acceptance criteria with tests/offline/test_use_case_authoring.py and the authoring verification record. Explain what GitHub Copilot, Skills, MCP, deterministic checks and approval each contributed. Record unavailable live evidence and production gaps.
evidence_required: A requirement-to-test summary with explicit exclusions.
failure_modes: Passing local tests cannot certify live permissions
steps.objective: Connect requirements to independent tests and leave live/production claims explicitly open.
steps.offline_equivalent: Review the existing practical and research teaching lenses.
steps.title: Verify outcomes and record limits

summary: Reuse synthetic manufacturing data to investigate duplicates, invalid relationships, prices, dates and region labels. GitHub Copilot helps explain checks and propose a remediation notebook; deterministic checks establish correctness. Rehearse notebook creation with separate approval and audit. Neither a data correction nor a cloud deployment is performed.
title: DQ-01: Investigate synthetic data quality with GitHub Copilot
